leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply filter properties to modify image appearance with blur, brightness, and contrast effects
Configure backdrop-filter to create frosted glass effects on overlay elements
Construct a photo gallery interface with interactive filter controls
Manipulate filter values dynamically using CSS custom properties
Integrate multiple filter functions to achieve complex visual transformations
Implement responsive filter adjustments for different screen sizes
Control filter intensity through precise numerical values and percentages
